# Fast Lane Traffic School

> Traffic school in West Palm Beach, Florida (Palm Beach County). In-person driver improvement classes at 800 S. Congress Ave., Suite B, West Palm Beach, FL 33406, plus state-approved online courses delivered by American Safety Council, an FLHSMV-approved provider. Open 7 days, 9 AM to 5 PM. Phone 561-623-7777. Se habla español.

## Facts
- Name: Fast Lane Traffic School (Google listing also shows "West Palm Beach Traffic School")
- Address: 800 S. Congress Ave., Suite B, West Palm Beach, FL 33406
- Phone: 561-623-7777
- Email: palmbeachtrafficschool@gmail.com
- Hours: Open 7 days, 9 AM to 5 PM
- Owner: Carlos Sevilla
- Languages: English, Spanish
- In-person classes: 4-hour BDI, 8-hour driver improvement, 8-hour youthful offender, 12-hour ADI, 4-hour TLSAE
- Online prices: 4-hour BDI $35, 8-hour $75, 12-hour ADI $99.95, TLSAE $35, mature driver $14.95, permit exam $29, permit prep $20
